unit_text: I did not decide to quit, and I did not forgive Sam.
I wrote "maybe Friday" on the whiteboard, erased it, wrote "maybe never," erased that too, and then stood there feeling stupid.
I keep telling myself I already know what it says, but I don't.
If I call back, it will be about the scan; if I don't, it will still be about the scan.
I am tired of how both options feel like the same answer.
